name: aisc-shapes
note: AISC Shapes Database v16.0 (August 2023), consistent with the AISC Steel Construction Manual, 16th Edition, published by the American Institute of Steel Construction and converted by scripts/import_aisc_shapes.ps1. AISC makes no warranty for the data; a licensed engineer must verify it for any specific application. Dimensions are in inches and properties in powers of inches. iz is AISC Ix and iy is AISC Iy; properties keep AISC's names, so Zx, Sx and rx go with iz. Single angles (L) and double angles (2L) are not included.
